name: Gift3d Hands
description: Gift3d Hands is a warm, down-to-earth studio for healthy locs, neat braids, and natural hair care — talented hands, real care, and styles that let your natural beauty shine.

hero.title: Talented hands. Healthy hair.
hero.subtitle: Starter locs, retwists, braids, and natural styles done with care — book your appointment with Gift3d Hands today.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Loctician
stylists.bio: The founder of Gift3d Hands believes healthy hair starts with care. She specialises in locs, braids, and natural styles, and every client gets her full attention, gentle hands, and a style they love.

reviews.name: Ebony S.
reviews.text: My starter locs came out so neat and even. She really took her time and explained how to care for them. Truly gifted hands!

reviews.name: Courtney A.
reviews.text: Best retwist I've had in a long time. Gentle, no tension, and my locs look healthy and fresh.

reviews.name: Jalen R.
reviews.text: Chill atmosphere and great conversation. My two-strand twists lasted for weeks.

reviews.name: Tierra M.
reviews.text: She did my daughter's braids and they were perfect. So patient and kind. We'll definitely be back!
